title: Norman Granz tours in 1946 and 1947
summary: He made two tours of eight to ten weeks, not two years; Granz kept only Ella and Oscar Peterson steadily.

blocks.x: You -- did you work for Norman Granz for two years, in '46 and '47, before you left or was that just --

Just tours -- just parts of those two years, the spots -- a tour wouldn't last over eight or ten weeks, you know, so I made two tours with him really, two tours would sound better than two years, because Norman never kept anything going for two years. Only attractions he ever had was Ella and Oscar Peterson, those -- he worked them steady, but he didn't keep anything with them.
Of course, Ella always used a trio, as I know of. Tommy Flanagan's been playing for her now about 17 years, her little group.
